- **Deterministic Strategy**（下路径）：privileged environment feedback → trajectory τ_det → 产出 (s_det, d_det)
- 两条路径 **merge** → **Episode-Level Labeling** (Algorithm 1) → 产出 ℓ ∈ {det-pref, int-pref, no-pref}
